messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: rule=HTTP_5xx_rate spike; source=gateway-prod; count=182 in 60s; pd-incident=https://pd.redwood.example/incidents/PD12345 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Auto-ack disabled for this policy due to noise suppression window. Escalating to engineering on-call.
maria: acked. seeing a lot of duplicate pages from PD, looks like same symptom repeated — 502s from inference-gateway across multiple AZs.
ben: @maria thanks. are logs showing upstream retries or a retry-loop?
maria: initial traces show repeated 502s with X-Req-Retry: 3 and timeout at the gateway. Some backend pods returned 200 intermittently.
ashley: pushing into #eng-sre — is this a thundering-herd on cold caches or a real backend regression?
kevin: quick check: kv-cache eviction spikes around the same time; maybe cache backend overloaded. metrics: kvcache.latency p95 250ms -> 900ms.
oncall-sre: i'm on it, switching to pager rotation. pausing autopager dedupe window while we triage.
ben: if KV backend is overloaded, we'll see cascade. can we temporarily route inference requests to fallback pool (lower capacity but stable)?
maria: issuing routing override to inference-fallback pool now: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/route -d '{"route":"inference-fallback","match":"all"}'` (dry run then apply)
incident-bot: route change pending approval by ops.
oncall-sre: approved, apply now.
kevin: applied, traffic shift ~15% so far. 5xx rate trending down from 18% -> 6% in 2 mins.
ashley: great. start silencing PD rule for 10m to avoid noise while we stabilize: `pdctl silence PD12345 --duration 10m --reason "mitigating duplicate pages during reroute"`
pagerduty-bot: Silence created by ashley.
ben: digging into backend logs — a retry loop: client retries + gateway adaptive retry policy causing duplicates. We need to throttle client retries and backoff.
maria: adding temporary gateway header rewrite to limit retry attempts: `X-Client-Retries: 1`. Deploying config patch.
oncall-sre: can we confirm customer impact? any customer tickets?
kevin: Internal monitoring shows increased latency but only a handful of customers hit error budgets. No P0 customer tickets yet.
ashley: notify CS to prepare a heads-up message if errors persist > 15m.
ben: patch rolled out to gateway canary. Observability: 5xx rate dropping to 2.1% and kvcache p95 recovering to 220ms.
maria: leaving the routing override in place for 10 mins to let caches warm.
ashley: keeping silence for PD rule until we see stable p95 < 1% for 5m.
oncall-sre: continuing watch. tagging for postmortem: investigate why autopager generated duplicate paging signals and tighten dedupe. cc: @eng-sre, @oncall-sre.
ben: probable causes to record: kvcache pressure -> backend retries -> gateway retry amplification -> PD alert flood. Action items: 1) tighten PD dedupe window, 2) add gateway retry cap, 3) increase KV cache alerts, 4) run load test on cache warmup.
maria: will create the incident ticket and link diagnostics + logs + graph snapshots.
pagerduty-bot: PD incident updated: PD12345 state=acknowledged assignees=[maria, ben, oncall-sre]
oncall-sre: handing off to morning shift in 10m with status=stabilized; will follow up on postmortem items. :white_check_mark:
ashley: thx all. closing temporary routing in 12m unless we see regression.
kevin: final check: no customer-facing alerts and error rate under threshold. monitoring continue.
incident-bot: thread archived to incidents channel; incident link=https://pd.redwood.example/incidents/PD12345/details
